execution: Agent-run with explicit user approval: one manual case (12 Nov) and one batch of ten via Alma-Acquisitions-Automation scripts/close_invoices.py (13 Nov). Raw logs kept locally under output/invoice_closer (gitignored).
scope: 11 one-line Rialto invoices (owner AC1) linked to one E_BOOK_OT order line each, line status WAITING_FOR_INVOICE, title with an Available portfolio; plus one PRINTED_BOOK_OT control.

process.observed: Reply already showed Ready to be Paid / APPROVED / NOT_PAID; order line CLOSED on the first GET after the reply in all 11.

pay.observed: Invoice CLOSED / PAID, workflow {} , voucher fields recorded, order line still CLOSED.

rerun: Second run over the same set: 10 of 10 ALREADY_CLOSED, no writes.

print_control.observed: Invoice stayed InReview / PENDING / NOT_PAID for 3 minutes; order line stayed SENT; no error returned.

alert_observation: One e-book invoice carried DIFF_PRICE_THAN_POLINE and still advanced and closed.
api_facts: GET /acq/po-lines with status=ALL excludes CLOSED lines; status=ALL_WITH_CLOSED includes them
Item receipt date is item_data.arrival_date; receiving_date was absent
limits: Order (PO) closure not observable via API
